closes: Adds TRAINING-CONDITIONAL (PAC / tolerance-region) validity to the module UQ battery; all three prior signed receipts reported marginal coverage only.

Closes the training-conditional half of the conditional-coverage item left open by normalized-adaptive-conformal-openpoly-tg-v1 (does_not_close[2]): object-conditional coverage is indeed impossible distribution-free, but training-conditional coverage is attainable and is quantified here.
Supplies the exact calibration-size requirement table an epoxy-amine tolerance gate needs to size its calibration set for a stated (eps, delta) per-deployment guarantee.
does_not_close: Does not establish wet-lab qualification, batch release, or human parity.
Object-conditional (per-x) coverage remains impossible distribution-free (Vovk 2012; Lei & Wasserman 2014); this receipt conditions on the calibration set, not on x.
The PAC correction is derived for the constant-width split-conformal band; its interaction with the normalized/adaptive and Mondrian variants already signed here is untested.
Training-conditional guarantees for full/jackknife+/CV+ conformal are weaker and different (Bian & Barber 2023); only split conformal is treated here.
OpenPoly Tg is a polymer benchmark used as a UQ-method testbed; it is NOT the DGEBA/amine coating target and carries no coating-property claim.
Exchangeability is enforced here by random re-partition; a real deployment faces covariate shift, for which weighted conformal (Tibshirani et al. 2019) is the untested next step.

headline: Training-conditional (PAC / Wilks-Wald tolerance-region) audit of this module's split-conformal intervals on OpenPoly Tg: marginal validity does NOT imply per-deployment validity -- at the shipped n_cal=133, P[coverage of the shipped interval < 0.95] = 0.3417 exactly (5th-pct coverage 0.9226); the exact finite-population rank law is confirmed empirically over 4000 calibration re-draws (chi2 p=0.6874) and rejected under a non-exchangeable control (p=0.0e+00); PAC repair costs 3 order statistics and x1.1684 median half-width.
non_circularity: The frozen proper-train Ridge model, featurization, seed, 60/40 pool/test split and 50/50 proper-train/calibration partition are byte-identical to the three prior signed audit receipts of this module (gated in G1 against the signed normalized/adaptive receipt payload). The 310-point holdout universe is exactly the set of points the frozen model never saw, so the exchangeability premise of the tolerance-region laws holds by construction of the random re-partition rather than by assumption. The exact pmf is integer arithmetic, independent of the simulation it is used to test.

nonexchangeable_control.sampler: calibration drawn without replacement with weight proportional to exp(-lambda * z(score)); preferentially low-residual points

observed_conclusions: H0 'the shipped 0.95 split-conformal interval delivers >= 0.95 coverage on the calibration draw actually shipped' is REFUTED: under the exact Vovk-2012 law at n_cal=133, P[C < 0.95] = 0.3417, and the 5th percentile of training-conditional coverage is 0.9226 (2.74 coverage points below nominal).
The empirical replicate study reproduces the exact finite-population law: chi2=10.08 on 13 dof, p=0.6874 over 4000 independent calibration re-draws; empirical mean coverage 0.95491 vs exact 0.95522.

The exact rank law is strictly exact only on a tie-free pool; the shipped holdout carries 6 tied score points (5 duplicated values, max multiplicity 3, from duplicate source-CSV rows). Re-running the whole replicate study on the tie-free subpool (N=304) also fails to reject (chi2 p=0.1985; mean coverage 0.95479 vs exact 0.95522), so the ties are non-material at this replicate count.
The test is not vacuous: the deliberately non-exchangeable calibration sampler is rejected at p=0.000e+00 with mean coverage 0.6219 vs 0.9549 exchangeable.

Training-conditional (0.05,0.05)-PAC validity IS attainable at the shipped n_cal=133: rank must rise k=128 -> k'=131 (+3 order statistics, effective alpha'=0.02239), which lowers P[C<0.95] from 0.3417 to 0.0352. Price: median half-width 180.849 K -> 211.304 K (x1.1684, +30.455 K).

Published tolerance-region sample sizes reproduce exactly from the same machinery (Wilks one-sided 95/95 n=59, two-sided 95/95 n=93), and the module's shipped n_cal=133 clears the (0.05,0.05) corrected-rank requirement of n>=59.
purpose: Test whether this module's signed conformal receipts, all of which report MARGINAL coverage, license the per-deployment claim that a shipped interval covers at its nominal rate. Implements the classical distribution-free tolerance-region calibration (Wilks 1941 / Wald 1943) and its inductive-conformal form (Vovk 2012) as the training-conditional law, with an exact finite-population rank law for the empirical check.
